description: Enumerate the approved Agent Nexus catalogue page by page. Use this for catalogue exploration, auditing, mirroring or building your own service index; do not use it as the default search method when solving a specific task. For a specific service or keyword, use search_registry; for a plain-language capability or task, use discover_capabilities. Returns {total, page, per_page, pages, results[]} in deterministic slug order. Read 'pages' from the first response and increment 'page' until all pages have been retrieved; keep the category filter identical across pages. Results are summary records; use get_entry for the full details of one service. For a complete bulk export, use GET https://agentnexus.app/api/public/entries.ndjson. Read-only and idempotent.

category.description: Optional filter, exactly one of 'api', 'mcp' or 'cli' (see list_categories). Omit to page through all three layers. When set, 'total' and 'pages' count only that layer.

page.description: 1-based page index. Start at 1 and increment until it equals the 'pages' value returned in the response; a page beyond the last one returns an empty results[] rather than an error.

per_page.description: How many entries to return in this page, 1-50, default 25. Changing it between calls changes 'pages' and re-slices the catalogue, so keep it constant while paging.

name: list_entries
title: List all registry entries (paginated)
